eligibility_evidence: Role: Senior Azure Infrastructure Consultant / Cloud Infrastructure Engineer Experience: 12–15+ years Specialization: Microsoft Azure, Hybrid Cloud, Infrastructure Modernization, Azure Virtual Desktop, Identity & Security, Migration and Disaster Recovery.

Job Summary Experienced Senior Azure Infrastructure Consultant responsible for designing, implementing, migrating, managing, and stabilizing enterprise-scale Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud environments.
Experienced working with large-scale infrastructure supporting 1,500+ servers, 2,000+ endpoints, and multi-region hybrid environments, particularly within the Canadian energy sector.
Design hybrid cloud architectures integrating Azure with on-premises VMware and Hyper-V environments.

Translate business requirements into technical Azure solutions.
